title: Standalone auth deploy of RF-177/RF-178 (#703, #705), coordinated with iOS RF-1012
acceptance: The owner has decided RF-180 (native sign-out Origin), and main carries that decision.
Deployed from the Air on its own (auth changes only) via deployment-runbook.md, with the owner's explicit deploy permission; HISTORY records the Worker version, rollback version and smoke results.

Post-deploy: POST /api/v1/auth/session on an aged session returns 200 with no Set-Cookie and extends the row; a native-shaped sign-out revokes the session (per the RF-180 decision); browser sign-in and get-session refresh still work.

iOS RF-1012 (cookie with no client-side expiry, /auth/session at launch and foreground) ships to the owner's devices close to this deploy, since a pre-RF-1012 build keeps its 7-day client expiry and gets no refreshed cookie after option C.
nextAction: Owner decides RF-180, then gives deploy permission on the Air.
